SELECT TOP 100 concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code FROM omop.concept WHERE domain_id='Measurement' AND LOWER(concept_name) LIKE 'potassium [moles/volume]%' AND (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%serum%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%plasma%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%blood%') ORDER BY concept_name

WITH params AS (
    SELECT CAST(DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(DATEADD(month, -23, GETDATE())), MONTH(DATEADD(month, -23, GETDATE())), 1) AS date) AS start_date,
           CAST(GETDATE() AS date) AS end_date
), months AS (
    SELECT start_date AS month_start FROM params
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATEADD(month, 1, month_start) FROM months, params WHERE month_start < DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(params.end_date), MONTH(params.end_date), 1)
), ckd_roots AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
    WHERE standard_concept = 'S' AND domain_id = 'Condition'
      AND (
        LOWER(concept_name) LIKE 'chronic kidney disease stage 3%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE 'chronic kidney disease stage 4%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE 'chronic kidney disease stage 5%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE 'hypertension in chronic kidney disease stage 3%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE 'hypertension in chronic kidney disease stage 4%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE 'hypertension in chronic kidney disease stage 5%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE 'hypertensive heart and chronic kidney disease stage 3%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE 'hypertensive heart and chronic kidney disease stage 4%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE 'hypertensive heart and chronic kidney disease stage 5%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE 'malignant hypertensive chronic kidney disease stage 3%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE 'malignant hypertensive chronic kidney disease stage 4%'
        OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE 'malignant hypertensive chronic kidney disease stage 5%'
      )
), ckd_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM ckd_roots)
    UNION SELECT concept_id FROM ckd_roots
), ace_arb_ingredients AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
    WHERE domain_id='Drug' AND concept_class_id='Ingredient' AND standard_concept='S'
      AND LOWER(concept_name) IN ('benazepril','captopril','enalapril','fosinopril','lisinopril','moexipril','perindopril','quinapril','ramipril','trandolapril','azilsartan','candesartan','eprosartan','irbesartan','losartan','olmesartan','telmisartan','valsartan')
), ace_arb_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM ace_arb_ingredients)
    UNION SELECT concept_id FROM ace_arb_ingredients
), potassium_concepts AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_id IN (3023103,3005456,46235078)
    UNION SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (3023103,3005456,46235078)
), severe_k_events AS (
    SELECT m.measurement_id, m.person_id, m.measurement_date, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(m.measurement_date), MONTH(m.measurement_date), 1) AS month_start
    FROM omop.measurement m
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE m.measurement_date >= p.start_date AND m.measurement_date <= p.end_date
      AND m.measurement_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM potassium_concepts)
      AND m.value_as_number >= 5.5 AND m.value_as_number < 20
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
          WHERE co.person_id = m.person_id
            AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM ckd_concepts)
            AND co.condition_start_date <= m.measurement_date
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM omop.drug_exposure de
          WHERE de.person_id = m.person_id
            AND de.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM ace_arb_concepts)
            AND de.drug_exposure_start_date <= m.measurement_date
            AND COALESCE(de.drug_exposure_end_date, DATEADD(day, COALESCE(de.days_supply, 30), de.drug_exposure_start_date)) >= m.measurement_date
      )
)
SELECT CONVERT(varchar(7), mo.month_start, 120) AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT e.measurement_id) AS severe_hyperkalemia_events,
       COUNT(DISTINCT e.person_id) AS patients_with_severe_hyperkalemia
FROM months mo
LEFT JOIN severe_k_events e ON e.month_start = mo.month_start
GROUP BY mo.month_start
ORDER BY mo.month_start
OPTION (MAXRECURSION 100)
